verdict: Paid campaigns have been paused 12 days; relaunch is this week.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 17 and has not run since — 12 consecutive days of zero spend and zero new leads as of September 28. Over the full 28-day window, you received 82 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $15.81, with all activity concentrated in the first half of the period. Campaigns are being relaunched this week alongside conversion tracking fixes on Google Ads, which recorded $301 in spend this period with no measurable results due to a tracking issue. Google's conversion measurement is being repaired and verified before that budget runs again. Once both channels are back live and tracking cleanly, lead volume should resume at or above the earlier pace.
